author: resepignev
body:
! - ALL CREDIT GOES TO THE ORIGINAL CREATOR SWEEEPER - !

Name: Proelium
Authors: Sweeeper, resepignev
Info: 
Red vs blue, approximately room for about 15 players in each team, Three monuments (Right, Middle and Left)
Contains diamonds, iron, and gold. There's also one notch apple in the middle, but it's very risky to get to it.



Images: http://imgur.com/a/Nta0s 
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/3r74l9c2c3l388q/proelium.zip
XML: http://pastebin.com/Mf0muBEL

ORIGINAL THREAD: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/d495b97a4

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body: No offense but this map had awful gameplay and shouldn't have been brought back from death. It looks nice and all, but the monument placement makes it really hard to rush once defenders build any sort of protection. and the narrow lanes make it really easy to get knocked into the void. plus it takes too long to get from one side of the map to the other(real pain in the ass). -1
